note: 完整文本，音频未验，不填时间轴。CPU运行时throttling不同于ResourceQuota准入拒绝，也不同于requests导致的调度等待。资源修改须核容量、租户配额与授权；不能无条件提高或移除limits。未来回访不计实绩。

series.title: CPU限制与配额：运行慢和创建失败不是一回事
series.premise: pricing延迟上升，运行副本受半核CPU限制；扩容又被命名空间CPU配额拒绝。平台须区分两条路径并做获批的小范围资源调整。
series.outcome: 受控对比支持CPU限制造成延迟的判断。先按需求和容量证据批准命名空间额度，再将一副本request从四分之一核调至半核、limit从半核调至一核。核准调度、对照压测后分批修复，长期保留成本归属、需求分析和容量评审。

Priya.role: Incident coordinator and resource change approver

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 用于调度等用途的资源请求量
按实际需求配置工作负载资源

recycling.note: 只使用既有库、S03-S07和本场此前表达；未来候选不记实绩。

dialogues.title: 延迟先报警，扩容也失败
dialogues.premise: pricing延迟升至九百毫秒，自动扩容没有新增副本。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分别识别正在运行的慢请求与新增副本失败。

lines.en: We're over the latency budget. Pricing requests now take about nine hundred milliseconds.
lines.zh: 我们超了延迟预算，pricing请求现在约九百毫秒。

lines.en: Which percentile and observation window? Averages could hide a different pattern.
lines.zh: 哪个百分位，哪个观察窗口？均值可能掩盖不同模式。

lines.en: The ninety-fifth percentile, over five minutes. Traffic is flat against the previous window.
lines.zh: 五分钟的九十五百分位，流量和前一窗口持平。

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, pricing only, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调，确认一下，目前只有pricing，对吧？

lines.en: That's the confirmed scope. Check dependent services before broadening the claim.
lines.zh: 这是已确认范围，扩大结论前先查依赖服务。

lines.en: The scale-up attempt failed too. I'll separate creation errors from running-container symptoms.
lines.zh: 扩容尝试也失败，我把创建错误与运行容器症状分开。

lines.en: Good, those might have different causes. Don't assume one resource fix solves both.
lines.zh: 好，两者可能原因不同，不要假定一次资源修改解决全部。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for evidence? A rough first comparison is enough.
lines.zh: 那么，取证预计多久？先有大致对比就够。

lines.en: Two minutes for matched metrics. We need timestamps from the same interval.
lines.zh: 匹配指标需要两分钟，要用同一时段的时间戳。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is resource pressure. I'll check limits and admission events separately.
lines.zh: 当前假设是资源压力，我分别查limits和准入事件。

dialogues.title: CPU限制与延迟同窗出现
dialogues.premise: 延迟与扩容失败分别取证，开始关联容器CPU指标。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解限制周期比例不能直接当作丢失CPU时间比例。

lines.en: CPU throttling increased in that window. Running containers hit their configured allowance.
lines.zh: 该窗口CPU限制增加，运行容器用到了配置额度。

lines.en: Which counter are you comparing? Throttled time differs from throttled period counts.
lines.zh: 比较的是哪个计数？受限时间与受限周期数不同。

lines.en: Both, with rates over matching intervals. The period ratio isn't lost CPU percentage.
lines.zh: 两个都有，用同窗速率，周期比例不是损失CPU百分比。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, correlation isn't proof, right? Keep the working hypothesis qualified.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，相关不等于证实，对吧？假设要保留限定。

lines.en: Exactly. A busy worker could also wait on other resources at times.
lines.zh: 正是这样，繁忙工作进程有时也可能等待其他资源。

lines.en: We're missing the latency budget consistently. Dependency timings look stable in these samples.
lines.zh: 我们持续超延迟预算，这些样本里的依赖耗时稳定。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on those. Match request classes before comparing performance.
lines.zh: 我继续关注这些，比较性能前匹配请求类型。

lines.en: I'm on it. Maybe expensive requests contribute, but the traffic mix looks unchanged.
lines.zh: 我来查，可能昂贵请求有影响，但流量组成看起来没变。

lines.en: Check node pressure next. Runtime limits can throttle even on an idle node.
lines.zh: 接下来查节点压力，即使节点空闲，运行时上限也能限CPU。

lines.en: So, don't raise anything yet. We'll test the competing explanations first.
lines.zh: 那么，先不提高任何值，先验证竞争解释。

dialogues.title: 节点有余量不代表容器无限CPU
dialogues.premise: 受限指标与延迟相关，但节点故障或竞争尚待检查。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分节点余量与容器运行时上限。

lines.en: There's no node saturation in these samples. Node conditions and runtime health look normal.
lines.zh: 这些样本没显示节点饱和，节点条件和运行时健康正常。

lines.en: Affected replicas sit on different nodes. That's our blast radius, not one failing host.
lines.zh: 受影响副本在不同节点，影响不是单台故障主机。

lines.en: Check competing workloads across those nodes. Aggregate usage can conceal short bursts.
lines.zh: 检查这些节点上的竞争负载，总使用量可能掩盖短突发。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, don't drain nodes, right? We haven't found node failure.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，不排空节点，对吧？还没找到节点故障。

lines.en: Traffic is flat, including request mix. CPU throttling persists across the affected replicas.
lines.zh: 流量包括请求组成都持平，受影响副本持续受CPU限制。

lines.en: That supports a container-level explanation. It doesn't eliminate every transient contention event.
lines.zh: 这支持容器层解释，但不能排除每次瞬时竞争。

lines.en: We can rule that out as confirmed node failure. I'll check effective resource settings next.
lines.zh: 可以排除已证实节点故障这个说法，接下来查生效资源设置。

lines.en: Compare observed values, not repository defaults. Admission policies may inject resource settings.
lines.zh: 比较实际值，不是仓库默认值，准入策略可能注入资源设置。

lines.en: So, maybe the defaults explain this. Keep that tentative until the specs match.
lines.zh: 那么，也许默认值能解释，配置核对前保持暂定。

lines.en: I'll pull the application demand estimate. Free node capacity isn't automatic change approval.
lines.zh: 我拿应用需求估计，节点有空余不等于自动获准变更。

dialogues.title: 半核上限需要受控验证
dialogues.premise: 未发现节点故障，继续核对容器资源与工作负载需求。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出上限、请求量与修改限制所需的容量核查。

lines.en: The CPU limit is half a core. Its request is a quarter core.
lines.zh: CPU上限是半核，请求量是四分之一核。

lines.en: Those settings govern different things. Requests influence scheduling; limits constrain runtime usage.
lines.zh: 两项作用不同，requests影响调度，limits约束运行时使用。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is an undersized limit. CPU throttling rises during request bursts.
lines.zh: 当前假设是上限太小，请求突发时CPU限制上升。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, no unlimited CPU, right? We need a bounded trial.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，不改成无限CPU，对吧？需要有边界试验。

lines.en: Agreed. Removing limits may shift contention. It won't demonstrate a sustainable allocation.
lines.zh: 同意，移除上限可能转移竞争，不能证明分配可持续。

lines.en: Maybe one core covers the bursts. I'll check both node capacity and tenant allowance.
lines.zh: 也许一核能覆盖突发，我核对节点容量和租户额度。

lines.en: Include replacement overlap in that calculation. A rollout may briefly run extra replicas.
lines.zh: 计算要包含替换重叠，发布可能暂时多运行副本。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for approval evidence? Broad resource changes, let's park that.
lines.zh: 那么，审批证据预计多久？大范围资源变更先搁置。

lines.en: I'll prepare a matched-load trial. Compare the unchanged replica with the canary.
lines.zh: 我准备匹配负载试验，对比未改副本和灰度副本。

lines.en: I'll confirm the demand envelope today. We won't change requests without reviewing it.
lines.zh: 我今天确认需求范围，评审前不改requests。

dialogues.title: 配额拒绝是准入，不是运行时限制
dialogues.premise: 拟做一核上限灰度，但此前扩容拒绝原因必须先明确。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区别命名空间准入、调度和CPU throttling。

lines.en: Let me tail the log. Admission rejected creation against the resource quota.
lines.zh: 我盯一下日志，准入因资源配额拒绝了创建。

lines.en: Which quota dimension was exhausted? Total requests and limits are separate counters.
lines.zh: 哪个配额维度耗尽？请求总量和上限总量是不同计数。

lines.en: The namespace limits total was exhausted. A new CPU limit exceeded that allowance.
lines.zh: 命名空间上限总量耗尽，新的CPU上限超了额度。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, no Pod was admitted, right? This isn't pending scheduling.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，没有Pod获准创建，对吧？不是等待调度。

lines.en: Correct. ResourceQuota doesn't throttle running containers. Runtime CPU control is a different mechanism.
lines.zh: 对，ResourceQuota不限制运行容器的CPU时间，运行时CPU控制是另一机制。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis covers latency, not creation. We need separate approval for quota changes.
lines.zh: 当前假设解释延迟，不解释创建，要另外审批配额变更。

lines.en: And a larger quota doesn't supply nodes. Capacity and placement still need validation.
lines.zh: 配额扩大也不会提供节点，容量和放置仍需验证。

lines.en: I'm on it. Maybe other tenants need that headroom; I'll consult their owners.
lines.zh: 我来查，也许其他租户需要这些余量，我问他们负责人。

lines.en: Calculate requests, limits, and replacement overlap. Keep each constraint explicit in approval.
lines.zh: 计算requests、limits和替换重叠，审批中逐项明确约束。

lines.en: So, no quota bypass. I'll review the bounded allocation with tenant owners.
lines.zh: 那么，不绕过配额，我与租户负责人评审有边界分配。

dialogues.title: 容量与授权齐备再改
dialogues.premise: 已确认准入拒绝来自上限总量，容量及租户额度评审完成。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住两类授权、精确资源修改和单副本试验范围。

lines.en: Quota approval is recorded now. Capacity review includes replacement overlap and tenant commitments.
lines.zh: 配额审批已记录，容量评审含替换重叠和租户承诺。

lines.en: Eligible nodes have sufficient requested capacity. Burst usage fits our reviewed safety margin.
lines.zh: 符合条件节点的请求容量足够，突发使用符合评审安全余量。

lines.en: The resource request becomes half a core. The CPU limit becomes one core.
lines.zh: 资源请求改为半核，CPU上限改为一核。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, one canary only, right? This remains a temporary workaround.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，只改一个灰度，对吧？这仍是临时缓解。

lines.en: What's the rollback trigger? Include tenant contention, not just pricing latency.
lines.zh: 回退触发条件是什么？包括租户竞争，不只pricing延迟。

lines.en: Worse customer errors or tenant contention means stop. Any capacity violation stops expansion too.
lines.zh: 客户错误恶化或租户竞争就停，任何容量违规也停止扩大。

lines.en: Check the resource quota after adjustment. Approval and actual admission must both hold.
lines.zh: 调整后核查资源配额，审批和实际准入必须都成立。

lines.en: So, I'll apply the approved revision. No unrelated resource settings will change.
lines.zh: 那么，我应用获批版本，不改无关资源设置。

lines.en: Maybe admission succeeds but placement waits. We'll inspect events before claiming execution succeeded.
lines.zh: 可能准入成功但放置要等，宣称执行成功前检查事件。

lines.en: I'll track the canary's request class. We need comparable work for performance evidence.
lines.zh: 我跟踪灰度请求类型，要有可比工作量才能形成性能证据。

dialogues.title: 准入成功后仍要核调度
dialogues.premise: 获批资源与配额已应用到一灰度副本，等待确认实际放置。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分创建、调度、启动和业务可用。

lines.en: Creation passed the resource quota check. The canary was briefly pending scheduling.
lines.zh: 创建通过配额检查，灰度曾短暂等待调度。

lines.en: Why was it pending? Requests, placement rules, and taints can all matter.
lines.zh: 为什么等待？requests、放置规则和污点都可能有影响。

lines.en: The resource request fits an eligible node. Scheduler events now confirm assignment there.
lines.zh: 资源请求符合一个可用节点，调度事件现在确认已分配。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, scheduled isn't serving yet, right? Check startup and readiness.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，已调度不等于已服务，对吧？检查启动和就绪。

lines.en: Correct. The image started successfully now. Readiness passed, and test traffic reaches it.
lines.zh: 对，镜像现已成功启动，就绪通过，测试流量到达。

lines.en: I'm on it for application checks. Maybe warm-up affects the first few samples.
lines.zh: 我做应用检查，预热可能影响最初几个样本。

lines.en: Allow the agreed warm-up window. Don't compare a cold replica with warm ones.
lines.zh: 留出约定预热窗口，不要拿冷副本比热副本。

lines.en: So, I'll keep an eye on placement. No full rollout until the comparison finishes.
lines.zh: 那么，我关注放置，对比完成前不全面发布。

lines.en: Record effective requests and limits too. Defaults could otherwise confuse the test.
lines.zh: 也记录生效requests和limits，否则默认值可能干扰试验。

lines.en: Both match the approved revision now. I'll retain admission and scheduler evidence separately.
lines.zh: 两者现在都符合获批版本，我分别保留准入和调度证据。

dialogues.title: 匹配负载后才判断效果
dialogues.premise: 灰度已启动就绪且配置符合审批，预热后开始对照复测。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别受限周期、延迟改善和因果结论的适用范围。

lines.en: Throttled periods fell on the canary. Compare that ratio with throttled time too.
lines.zh: 灰度受限周期下降，也把该比例与受限时间对比。

lines.en: It's within the latency budget now. Matched requests take about three hundred milliseconds.
lines.zh: 现在符合延迟预算，匹配请求约三百毫秒。

lines.en: And the unchanged control remains slower? Keep the observation windows identical.
lines.zh: 未改对照仍较慢吗？保持观察窗口一致。

lines.en: Yes, CPU throttling remains higher there. That supports the runtime-limit explanation here.
lines.zh: 是的，那里CPU限制仍较高，支持这里的运行时上限解释。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, not every workload benefits, right? This result is specific.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，不是所有负载都受益，对吧？结果有特定范围。

lines.en: Right, this demand and request mix. Let's keep it under observation during expansion.
lines.zh: 对，是这个需求和请求组成，扩大期间继续观察。

lines.en: So, maybe expand one replica next. Our application checks stayed clean throughout.
lines.zh: 那么，也许接着扩大一个副本，应用检查一直正常。

lines.en: Capacity approval covers that staged expansion. Check neighboring tenants after every replacement.
lines.zh: 容量审批覆盖这个分阶段扩大，每次替换后检查邻租户。

lines.en: All approved replacements are complete now. We're back to baseline in aggregate too.
lines.zh: 获批替换现在全部完成，总体指标也回到基线。

lines.en: Keep the monitoring window open still. Recovery doesn't settle the permanent allocation.
lines.zh: 继续保留监控窗口，恢复不代表永久分配已经定案。

dialogues.title: 配额额度不是资源采购
dialogues.premise: 分批修复恢复延迟，开始讨论临时分配的成本与长期容量。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分配额许可、调度容量与成本归属。

lines.en: The mitigation is holding now. We still need a capacity reservation decision.
lines.zh: 缓解现在持续有效，仍要决定容量预留。

lines.en: Resource quota isn't a node reservation. Raising it grants allowance, not physical capacity.
lines.zh: 资源配额不是节点预留，提高它给的是许可，不是物理容量。

lines.en: Our higher resource request affects placement. Do we need more nodes long term?
lines.zh: 较高资源请求影响放置，长期要增加节点吗？

lines.en: Not established yet. Measure peak overlap and tenant demand before buying capacity.
lines.zh: 还没证实，购买容量前测高峰重叠和租户需求。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, no permanent quota increase by default, right? Review has an expiry.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，不默认永久扩大配额，对吧？评审有到期点。

lines.en: Yes, Friday's review checks demand. Current settings remain until an approved replacement plan.
lines.zh: 对，周五评审核需求，获批替代方案前保留当前设置。

lines.en: Maybe optimize the expensive request path too. I have bandwidth for profiling tomorrow.
lines.zh: 也许还要优化昂贵请求路径，我明天有精力做剖析。

lines.en: So, charge additional demand to pricing. Don't silently take another tenant's committed headroom.
lines.zh: 那么，新增需求归pricing，不要悄悄占其他租户承诺余量。

lines.en: Compare customer latency against actual utilization. Requested capacity alone isn't the bill.
lines.zh: 对比客户延迟与实际利用率，请求容量本身不等于账单。

lines.en: I'll bring placement and burst data Friday. Cost decisions need the same technical boundaries.
lines.zh: 我周五提供放置和突发数据，成本决定需要相同技术边界。

dialogues.title: 把两条故障路径分别闭环
dialogues.premise: 服务恢复，临时额度待周五复核，应用优化和容量工作需要负责人。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分别复述延迟原因和创建拒绝原因，并抓住行动期限。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, CPU throttling delayed requests. Resource quota separately rejected creation.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，CPU限制拖慢请求，资源配额另行拒绝了创建。

lines.en: Scheduling used requests after admission succeeded. Keep those three mechanisms separate in documentation.
lines.zh: 准入成功后调度使用requests，文档里把三种机制分开。

lines.en: First action item: right-size the workload. I'll profile representative requests by Thursday.
lines.zh: 第一项任务是按需求配置负载，我周四前剖析代表性请求。

lines.en: I'll rerun peak-load comparisons Friday. Include errors, latency, and effects on neighbors.
lines.zh: 我周五重跑高峰对比，包括错误、延迟和邻租户影响。

lines.en: Requests and limits need approval, right? I'll add capacity checks to resource reviews.
lines.zh: requests和limits要审批，对吧？我把容量检查加入资源评审。

lines.en: Include quota and rollout overlap too. Don't recommend removing limits as a universal fix.
lines.zh: 也包含配额和发布重叠，不要把移除limits推荐为通用修复。

lines.en: So, we'll close the loop on Friday. Maybe the long-term allocation changes after profiling.
lines.zh: 那么，周五闭环，剖析后长期分配也许会调整。

lines.en: Current recovery is confirmed already. We'll keep the approved resources until the next decision.
lines.zh: 当前恢复已确认，下一次决定前保留获批资源。

lines.en: The monitoring record will stay available. Alert thresholds remain unchanged during this observation window.
lines.zh: 监控记录会保留，本次观察窗口内告警阈值保持不变。

lines.en: I'll document the admission failure separately. That prevents another misleading resource diagnosis.
lines.zh: 我单独记录准入失败，避免下次再做误导性资源诊断。
